paper_id: Natural Language Inference by Tree-Based Convolution and Heuristic Matching__oa_W2963241825
title: Natural Language Inference by Tree-Based Convolution and Heuristic Matching
motivation: 递归网络虽有结构敏感性，但训练时路径过长导致难以优化
problem_framing: 将NLI建模为两步骤的句子对匹配任务：先编码单句，再用启发式层组合
key_insight: 树结构卷积比递归网络传播路径更短，且显式使用元素级差异heuristics能带来优化收益
method_signature: TBCNN捕获结构语义 + concatenation/product/difference启发式匹配层
evaluation_criteria: SNLI数据集准确率；匹配复杂度O(1) vs O(n²)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 单独使用element-wise product效果显著劣于concatenation或difference
evidence_for_taste: TBCNN is more robust than sequential convolution in terms of word order distortion
explicitly specifying this heuristic significantly improves the performance
the matching part counts 1.71% of the total time during prediction
the element-wise difference matching layer does not add to model complexity
using element-wise product alone is significantly worse
thinking_moves: 把结构敏感性从递归网络(路径长难训练)重新归属到树卷积(路径短易训练)
通过数学等价证明(difference可吸收到concat)反衬出显式建模的优化价值
把syntactic parsing不是当作最终目标而是当作feature detector的约束先验
